newsitem.title: GERMANY: Alcoa takes over Germany's AVH outright.
newsitem.headline: Alcoa takes over Germany's AVH outright.

text.p: Alcoa, the world's biggest aluminium company, will take over the 40 percent of Germany's AVH Extrusions Presswerk GmbH & Co KG, Hannover it does not already own, AVH said on Thursday.

Alcoa -- the Aluminium Co of America -- bought 60 percent of the AVH works in a joint venture deal back in 1993. A final contract is expected on buying out the remainder by the end of the year, AVH said in a statement.
AVH produces and markets pressed and finished aluminium products for the European aircraft, car, machine-building and defence industries. It will be integrated into Alcoa's European operations.
No further details of the transaction were given.
